title.en: A Day in the Life of a Young Muslim
A day in the life of a young Muslim

intro.en: Read how a young Muslim spends his day: waking up with a dua, entering and leaving places with the right foot, praying Fajr in the mosque, reading Quran, and doing his work well. Read slowly and notice the sunnah manners.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke ek naujawan Musalman apna din kaise guzarta hai: dua ke saath uthna, sahi paon se andar aur bahar jana, Fajr masjid mein parhna, Quran parhna aur apna kaam acchi tarah karna. Aahista parhein aur sunnat adaab par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: اقْرَأْ كَيْفَ يَقْضي ناشِئٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَوْمَهُ: يَسْتَيْقِظُ بِدُعاء، وَيَدْخُلُ الأَماكِنَ وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْها بِالرِّجْلِ الصَّحيحَة، وَيُصَلّي الفَجْرَ في المَسْجِد، وَيَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ، وَيُتْقِنُ عَمَلَهُ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَلاحِظْ آدابَ السُّنَّة.

dialogue.ar: إذا بَزَغَ فَجْرُ يَوْم جَديد، يَدْعو الناشِئُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ بِالدُّعاءِ المَشْهور.
dialogue.tr: idhā bazagha fajru yawmin jadīd, yadʿū n-nāshiʾu baʿda an yastayqiẓa bid-duʿāʾi l-mashhūr
dialogue.en: When the dawn of a new day breaks, after waking up the young Muslim makes the well-known dua.
dialogue.ur: Jab naye din ki fajr ho jati hai, to naujawan uthne ke baad mashhoor dua karta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَدْخُلُ بِرِجْلِهِ اليُسْرى مَكانَ قَضاءِ الحاجَةِ، وَيَخْرُجُ بِرِجْلِهِ اليُمْنى.
dialogue.tr: yadkhulu birijlihi l-yusrā makāna qaḍāʾi l-ḥāja, wa yakhruju birijlihi l-yumnā
dialogue.en: He enters the toilet with his left foot and leaves with his right foot.
dialogue.ur: Woh baitul khala mein ulta (baayan) paon rakh kar jata hai aur seedha (daayan) paon rakh kar nikalta hai.

dialogue.ar: لا يَسْتَقْبِلُ القِبْلَةَ وَلا يَسْتَدْبِرُها وَقْتَ قَضاءِ الحاجَةِ إذا كانَ في الفَضاء.
dialogue.tr: lā yastaqbilu l-qibla wa lā yastadbiruhā waqta qaḍāʾi l-ḥāja idhā kāna fil-faḍāʾ
dialogue.en: He does not face the Qibla or turn his back to it when relieving himself in the open.
dialogue.ur: Khuli jagah haajat ke waqt na qibla ki taraf munh karta hai na pusht.

dialogue.ar: يَحْرِصُ الناشِئُ عَلى تَجَنُّبِ النَّجاساتِ حَتّى لا تُصيبَ ثِيابَهُ أَوْ جِسْمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥriṣu n-nāshiʾu ʿalā tajannubi n-najāsāt, ḥattā lā tuṣība thiyābahu aw jismah
dialogue.en: He is careful to avoid impurities so that they do not touch his clothes or body.
dialogue.ur: Woh najasaton se bachne ka khayal rakhta hai taake kapdon ya jism ko na lagein.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ الناشِئُ، وَيَقولُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ مِنَ الوُضوءِ دُعاءَ الوُضوء.
dialogue.tr: thumma yatawaḍḍaʾu n-nāshiʾ, wa yaqūlu baʿda an yantahiya mina l-wuḍūʾi duʿāʾa l-wuḍūʾ
dialogue.en: Then he makes wudu, and when he finishes he says the dua of wudu.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh wuzu karta hai aur wuzu ke baad wuzu ki dua parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإذا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَبْلَ الفَجْرِ فَإِنَّهُ يُصَلّي بِضْعَ رَكَعاتٍ، تَهَجُّداً لِلّهِ تَعالى.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā istayqaẓa qabla l-fajr fa-innahu yuṣallī biḍʿa rakaʿāt, tahajjudan lillāhi taʿālā
dialogue.en: If he wakes before Fajr he prays a few rak'ahs, as night prayer for Allah.
dialogue.ur: Agar Fajr se pehle uth jaye to Allah ke liye tahajjud ke taur par chand rakaten parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإذا طَلَعَ الفَجْرُ أَدّى سُنَّةَ الفَجْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ تَلِيهِما صَلاةُ الفَجْر.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā ṭalaʿa l-fajru addā sunnata l-fajr rakʿatayn, talīhimā ṣalātu l-fajr
dialogue.en: When dawn rises he prays the two rak'ahs of Fajr sunnah, followed by the Fajr prayer.
dialogue.ur: Jab fajr tulu ho to Fajr ki do rakat sunnat parhta hai, phir Fajr ki namaz.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْرِصُ عَلى أَدائِها جَماعَةً في مَسْجِدِ الحَيِّ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḥriṣu ʿalā adāʾihā jamāʿatan fī masjidi l-ḥayy
dialogue.en: He makes sure to pray it in congregation in the neighbourhood mosque.
dialogue.ur: Aur mohalle ki masjid mein jamaat se parhne ka ahtimam karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ هذا يَبْدَأُ يَوْمَهُ بِقِراءَةِ ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda hādhā yabdaʾu yawmahu biqirāʾati mā tayassara mina l-qurʾāni l-karīm
dialogue.en: After this he starts his day by reading what is easy of the Noble Quran.
dialogue.ur: Iske baad woh din ki shuruaat Quran ka jitna aasani se ho parhne se karta hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ إذا عادَ إلى البَيْتِ، يَحْرِصُ عَلى أَداءِ الصَّلَواتِ جَماعَةً.
dialogue.tr: thumma idhā ʿāda ilā l-bayt, yaḥriṣu ʿalā adāʾi ṣ-ṣalawāti jamāʿah
dialogue.en: Then when he returns home, he makes sure to pray the prayers in congregation.
dialogue.ur: Phir ghar wapas aa kar namazen jamaat se parhne ka ahtimam karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُؤَدّي الناشِئُ واجِباتِهِ اليَوْمِيَّةَ في وَقْتِها عَلى أَحْسَنِ وَجْه وَأَتَمِّ حال.
dialogue.tr: wa yuʾaddī n-nāshiʾu wājibātihi l-yawmiyya fī waqtihā ʿalā aḥsani wajhin wa atammi ḥāl
dialogue.en: The young Muslim does his daily duties on time, in the best and most complete way.
dialogue.ur: Naujawan apne rozana ke farz kaam waqt par behtareen aur mukammal tarike se karta hai.

q.en: The young Muslim enters the toilet with which foot?
q.ur: Naujawan baitul khala mein kaun sa paon pehle rakhta hai?
q.ar: بِأَيِّ رِجْلٍ يَدْخُلُ الناشِئُ المُسْلِمُ الخَلاءَ؟

options: He wakes up / Woh jaagta hai
He travels / Woh safar karta hai

q.ur: "Jamaat" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الصَّلاةَ مَعَ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِد؟

q.en: What does he read after Fajr to begin his day?
q.ur: Fajr ke baad din shuru karne ke liye kya parhta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقْرَأُ بَعْدَ الفَجْرِ لِيَبْدَأَ يَوْمَه؟

intro.en: Practise what you read: true or false sentences, finding the sentence that gives a meaning, opposites, plurals and synonyms. These word pairs help you build a stronger vocabulary.
intro.ur: Jo parha usay yaad karne ki mashq: sahi ya ghalat jumle, kisi matlab ka jumla dhoondna, ulte alfaaz, jama aur hum-maani alfaaz. Yeh jode aapka zakheera-e-alfaaz mazboot karte hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما قَرَأْتَ: جُمَلٌ صَحيحَةٌ أَوْ خاطِئَة، وَإيجادُ الجُمْلَةِ الَّتي تُعْطي مَعْنىً، وَالأَضْدادُ وَالجُموعُ وَالمُرادِفات. هَذِهِ الأَزْواجُ مِنَ الكَلِماتِ تُقَوّي ثَرْوَتَكَ اللُّغَوِيَّة.

dialogue.ar: أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ يَفْعَلُهُ المُسْلِمُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ هُوَ الصَّلاةُ.
dialogue.tr: awwalu shayʾin yafʿaluhu l-muslimu baʿda an yastayqiẓa huwa ṣ-ṣalā
dialogue.en: The first thing a Muslim does after waking is prayer. (true or false?)
dialogue.ur: Jaagne ke baad Musalman ka pehla kaam namaz hai. (sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: ما أَوَّلُ دُعاءٍ يَبْدَأُ بِهِ الناشِئُ يَوْمَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā awwalu duʿāʾin yabdaʾu bihi n-nāshiʾu yawmah?
dialogue.en: What is the first dua the young Muslim begins his day with?
dialogue.ur: Naujawan din ki shuruaat kis dua se karta hai?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يَدْخُلُ المُسْلِمُ المَسْجِدَ؟ وَكَيْفَ يَخْرُجُ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa yadkhulu l-muslimu l-masjid? wa kayfa yakhruj?
dialogue.en: How does a Muslim enter the mosque? And how does he leave?
dialogue.ur: Musalman masjid mein kaise dakhil hota hai? Aur kaise nikalta hai?

dialogue.ar: ماذا تُسَمَّى صَلاةُ ما قَبْلَ الفَجْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā tusammā ṣalātu mā qabla l-fajr?
dialogue.en: What is the prayer before Fajr called?
dialogue.ur: Fajr se pehle ki namaz ko kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما الهَدَفُ مِنَ التَّمارينِ الرِّياضِيَّةِ في الصَّباحِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-hadafu mina t-tamārīni r-riyāḍiyyati fiṣ-ṣabāḥ?
dialogue.en: What is the aim of morning exercise?
dialogue.ur: Subah ki warzish ka maqsad kya hai?

q.en: Which word is a synonym of «رَجَعَ» (he returned)?
q.ur: «رَجَعَ» ka hum-maani lafz kaun sa hai?

intro.en: In a sentence that starts with a noun (the mubtada), the part that completes the meaning is the khabar. The khabar can be a single word, a full sentence, or a prepositional or adverb phrase. Example: العِلْمُ نورٌ – 'Knowledge is light' (نور is a single-word khabar).
intro.ur: Jo jumla ism se shuru ho uski pehli cheez mubtada hoti hai, aur jo baat usay mukammal kare woh khabar hai. Khabar ek lafz ho sakti hai, poora jumla ho sakti hai, ya shibh-e-jumla (jaar majroor ya zarf). Misal: العِلْمُ نورٌ – 'Ilm roshni hai' (نور ek lafz ki khabar hai).
intro.ar: في الجُمْلَةِ الَّتي تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ (المُبْتَدَأ) يُسَمّى الجُزْءُ الَّذي يُتِمُّ المَعْنى الخَبَر. وَالخَبَرُ قَدْ يَكونُ كَلِمَةً واحِدَة، أَوْ جُمْلَة، أَوْ شِبْهَ جُمْلَة (جارّاً وَمَجْروراً أَوْ ظَرْفاً). مِثال: العِلْمُ نورٌ، فَـ «نورٌ» خَبَرٌ مُفْرَد.

dialogue.ar: العِلْمُ نورٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿilmu nūr
dialogue.en: Knowledge is light. (single word)
dialogue.ur: Ilm roshni hai. (mufrad khabar)

dialogue.ar: العِلْمُ شَأْنُهُ عَظيمٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿilmu shaʾnuhu ʿaẓīm
dialogue.en: Knowledge, its status is great. (a sentence as khabar)
dialogue.ur: Ilm, uski shaan bohat badi hai. (jumla ismiya khabar)

dialogue.ar: الزَّكاةُ تُطَهِّرُ النُّفوسَ.
dialogue.tr: az-zakātu tuṭahhiru n-nufūs
dialogue.en: Zakat purifies the souls. (verbal sentence)
dialogue.ur: Zakat nufoos ko paak karti hai. (jumla fi'liya)

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you. (prepositional phrase)
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati ho. (jaar majroor)

dialogue.ar: العَرَبِيَّةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿarabiyyatu bayna yadayk
dialogue.en: Arabic is between your hands. (adverb phrase)
dialogue.ur: Arabi aap ke haathon ke darmiyan hai. (zarf)

dialogue.ar: الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأولى.
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣabru ʿinda ṣ-ṣadmati l-ūlā
dialogue.en: Patience is at the first shock.
dialogue.ur: Sabr pehle sadme ke waqt hai.

q.ur: «العِلْمُ نورٌ» mein khabar kaun si hai?

q.en: «الزَّكاةُ تُطَهِّرُ النُّفوسَ»: the khabar is a:
q.ur: «الزَّكاةُ تُطَهِّرُ النُّفوسَ» mein khabar kya hai?

options: The part that completes the meaning of the subject / Woh hissa jo mubtada ko mukammal kare
The first word of the sentence / Jumle ka pehla lafz
A verb in the past / Fe'l-e-maazi
A question word / Sawal ka lafz

intro.en: Listen to the two parts of the audio (about sons and parents), then answer true or false and short questions. Questions ask who cries, who is loved, and how parents should raise their children. Parents are told to treat children fairly and to be careful with teenagers.
intro.ur: Audio ke do hisse suniye (bete aur walidain ke baare mein), phir sahi ya ghalat aur mukhtasar sawalat ke jawab dein. Walidain ko nasihat hai ke bachon ke saath insaaf karein aur nojawanon ke saath narmi aur samajhdari se pesh aayein.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى جُزْأَيِ التَّسْجيلِ (عَنِ الأَبْناءِ وَالوالِدَيْن)، ثُمَّ أَجِبْ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأ وَبِأَجْوِبَةٍ قَصيرَة. تَسْأَلُ الأَسْئِلَةُ: مَنْ يَبْكي؟ وَمَنْ يُحَبّ؟ وَكَيْفَ يُرَبّي الوالِدانِ أَبْناءَهُما؟ وَيُوصى الوالِدانِ بِالعَدْلِ بَيْنَ الأَبْناءِ وَبِالحَذَرِ مَعَ المُراهِقين.

dialogue.ar: مَتى يَبْكي الابْنُ الأَوَّلُ؟
dialogue.tr: matā yabkī l-ibnu l-awwal?
dialogue.en: When does the first son cry?
dialogue.ur: Pehla beta kab rota hai?

dialogue.ar: مَنِ الابْنُ الَّذي لا يُحِبُّهُ إخْوَتُهُ وَأَخَواتُهُ؟
dialogue.tr: mani l-ibnu lladhī lā yuḥibbuhu ikhwatuhu wa akhawātuh?
dialogue.en: Which son is not loved by his brothers and sisters?
dialogue.ur: Kaun sa beta hai jisse uske bhai behnen pyar nahi karte?

dialogue.ar: ما نَوْعُ التَّغَيُّراتِ الَّتي تَحْدُثُ لِلْمُراهِقِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā nawʿu t-taghayyurāti llatī taḥduthu lil-murāhiq?
dialogue.en: What kind of changes happen to a teenager?
dialogue.ur: Nojawan mein kis qism ki tabdiliyan aati hain?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ نُعامِلُ أَصْدِقاءَ أَوْلادِنا؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa nuʿāmilu aṣdiqāʾa awlādinā?
dialogue.en: How do we treat our children's friends?
dialogue.ur: Hum apne bachon ke doston ke saath kaisa sulook karen?

dialogue.ar: ما مَعْنى (يُفْسِدونَ وَلا يُصْلِحونَ)؟
dialogue.tr: mā maʿnā (yufsidūna wa lā yuṣliḥūn)?
dialogue.en: What is the meaning of 'they spread corruption and do not reform'?
dialogue.ur: 'Yufsidoona wa la yuslihoon' ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: Which is NOT a type of change a teenager goes through?
q.ur: Nojawan mein kaun si tabdili NAHI aati?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ لَيْسَتْ مِنَ التَّغَيُّراتِ الَّتي تُصيبُ المُراهِق؟

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner about your day: when you wake up, your first and last actions, and when you sleep. Then write about "A Day in My Life" using the given points, such as Fajr, Quran and your daily duties.
intro.ur: Apne saathi se apne din ke baare mein baat karne ki mashq: aap kab jaagte hain, pehla aur aakhri kaam kya hota hai aur kab sote hain. Phir diye gaye nukaat ki madad se 'Mere din ka ek din' likhein, jaise Fajr, Quran aur rozana ke kaam.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى الحَديثِ عَنْ يَوْمِك: مَتى تَسْتَيْقِظ، وَأَوَّلُ عَمَلٍ وَآخِرُ عَمَلٍ تَقومُ بِه، وَمَتى تَنام. ثُمَّ اكْتُبْ عَنْ «يَوْمٍ في حَياتي» مُسْتَعيناً بِالنِّقاطِ المُعْطاة، كَالفَجْرِ وَالقُرْآنِ وَواجِباتِكَ اليَوْمِيَّة.

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَصْحو مِنَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: matā taṣḥū mina n-nawm?
dialogue.en: When do you wake up?
dialogue.ur: Aap neend se kab uthte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما أَوَّلُ كَلامٍ تَقولُهُ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَصْحو؟
dialogue.tr: mā awwalu kalāmin taqūluhu baʿda an taṣḥū?
dialogue.en: What is the first thing you say after waking up?
dialogue.ur: Uthne ke baad aap sabse pehle kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما آخِرُ عَمَلٍ تَقومُ بِهِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ākhiru ʿamalin taqūmu bihi qabla n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What is the last thing you do before sleeping?
dialogue.ur: Sone se pehle aapka aakhri kaam kya hota hai?

dialogue.ar: أَنْ تَصْحوَ مُبَكِّراً أَمْ مُتَأَخِّراً؟
dialogue.tr: an taṣḥuwa mubakkiran am mutaʾakhkhiran?
dialogue.en: Is it better to wake up early or late?
dialogue.ur: Jaldi uthna behtar hai ya der se?

dialogue.ar: وَقْتُ الاسْتِيقاظِ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، دُعاءُ الصَّباحِ، صَلاةُ الفَجْرِ في المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: waqtu l-istīqāẓi mina n-nawm, duʿāʾu ṣ-ṣabāḥ, ṣalātu l-fajri fil-masjid
dialogue.en: Time of waking, the morning dua, Fajr prayer in the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Jaagne ka waqt, subah ki dua, masjid mein Fajr ki namaz.

q.ur: "Neend" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ وَقْتِ صَلاةٍ يَكونُ عِنْدَ غُروبِ الشَّمْس؟

q.en: «أَنْ تَصْحوَ مُبَكِّراً»: this means to wake up:

title.en: Spelling: the soft alif at the end of nouns
title.ur: Imla: Ism ke aakhir ki alif layyina

intro.en: A noun can end with a long ā sound written as alif (ا) or as yā-shaped alif (ى). Rule for three-letter words: if the alif comes from waw, write ا (عَصا); if from yā, write ى (فَتى). For words longer than three letters: if a yā comes before the alif, write ا (قَضايا); otherwise write ى (مُصْطَفى).
intro.ur: Ism ke aakhir mein 'aa' ki awaaz alif (ا) ya alif maqsura (ى) se likhi jati hai. Teen harfi lafz mein agar alif 'waw' se bana ho to ا likhte hain (عَصا), aur 'ya' se bana ho to ى (فَتى). Teen se zyada harf wale lafz mein agar alif se pehle 'ya' ho to ا (قَضايا), warna ى (مُصْطَفى).
intro.ar: قَدْ يَنْتَهي الاسْمُ بِأَلِفٍ لَيِّنَةٍ تُكْتَبُ أَلِفاً (ا) أَوْ ياءً بِلا نُقَطٍ (ى). في الاسْمِ الثُّلاثِيِّ: إِنْ كانَ أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ واواً كُتِبَتْ ا (عَصا)، وَإِنْ كانَ ياءً كُتِبَتْ ى (فَتى). وَفي ما زادَ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ: إِنْ سَبَقَتْها ياءٌ كُتِبَتْ ا (قَضايا)، وَإِلّا كُتِبَتْ ى (مُصْطَفى).

dialogue.ar: عَصا، عُلا، خُطا (أَصْلُها واو) وَتُكْتَبُ بِالأَلِفِ (ا).
dialogue.tr: ʿaṣā, ʿulā, khuṭā – aṣluhā wāw wa tuktabu bil-alif
dialogue.en: 'Staff, heights, steps' – origin is waw, written with alif.
dialogue.ur: 'Asa, ula, khuta' – asl waw hai, alif (ا) se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: فَتى، ذُرى، مُدى، غِنى (أَصْلُها ياء) وَتُكْتَبُ بِالياءِ (ى).
dialogue.tr: fatā, dhurā, mudā, ghinā – aṣluhā yāʾ wa tuktabu bil-yāʾ
dialogue.en: 'Youth, peaks, knife, wealth' – origin is yā, written with ى.
dialogue.ur: 'Fata, dhura, muda, ghina' – asl ya hai, ى se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: قَضايا، سَرايا، خَفايا، بَلايا (قَبْلَ الأَلِفِ ياء) وَتُكْتَبُ بِالأَلِفِ (ا).
dialogue.tr: qaḍāyā, sarāyā, khafāyā, balāyā – qabla l-alifi yāʾ
dialogue.en: 'Issues, patrols, secrets, trials' – a yā before the alif, written with alif.
dialogue.ur: 'Qazaya, saraya, khafaya, balaya' – alif se pehle ya hai, alif (ا) se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: مُصْطَفى، بُشْرى، دَعْوى، صُغْرى (غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ) وَتُكْتَبُ بِالياءِ (ى).
dialogue.tr: muṣṭafā, bushrā, daʿwā, ṣughrā – ghayru dhālik
dialogue.en: 'Chosen, good news, claim, smallest' – other cases, written with ى.
dialogue.ur: 'Mustafa, bushra, dawa, sughra' – baqi sab ko ى se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: لا عَدْوى وَلا طِيَرَة.
dialogue.tr: lā ʿadwā wa lā ṭiyara
dialogue.en: There is no contagion (by itself) and no bad omen.
dialogue.ur: Na chhoot (khud se) hai na badshagooni.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ طَلَبَ العُلا سَهِرَ اللَّيالي.
dialogue.tr: man ṭalaba l-ʿulā sahira l-layālī
dialogue.en: Whoever seeks high status stays awake nights.
dialogue.ur: Jo buland maqam chahta hai woh raaton jagta hai.

vocab.ur: chuna hua, Nabi ﷺ ka laqab

q.en: How is «عَصا» written at the end, and why?
q.ur: «عَصا» aakhir mein kaise likhte hain aur kyun?

options: With alif (ا), its origin is waw
With ى, its origin is yā
With ى, it has four letters
With alif, it is a verb

q.ur: «فَتى» kaise likha jata hai aur kyun?

options: With ى, its origin is yā
With alif, its origin is waw
With ى, it comes after yā

q.ur: «قَضايا» ka aakhir kaise likhte hain aur kyun?

options: With alif, a yā comes before the alif
With ى, it is a name
With ى, it is a verb
With alif, it has three letters

q.en: Which word is written with ى?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ى se likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الكَلِماتِ الآتِيَةِ تُكْتَبُ بِـ ى؟

title.ur: Qawaid: Khabar ko mubtada se pehle lana

intro.en: Usually the mubtada comes first and the khabar after it. But sometimes the khabar must come first, for example when it is a question word (أَيْنَ), when the mubtada is limited by «إِنَّما» or «ما … إلا», or when a pronoun in the mubtada refers back to the khabar (لِلصّائِمِ ثَوابُهُ). Example: في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ – 'In the class there is a student'.
intro.ur: Aam tor par mubtada pehle aur khabar baad mein aati hai. Lekin kabhi khabar ko pehle lana zaroori hota hai, jaise jab khabar sawali lafz ho (أَيْنَ), jab mubtada 'إِنَّما' ya 'ما … إلا' se mahdood ho, ya jab mubtada ki zameer khabar ki taraf laute (لِلصّائِمِ ثَوابُهُ). Misal: في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ – 'Class mein ek talib-e-ilm hai'.
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ المُبْتَدَأُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِيَ الخَبَر. لَكِنَّ الخَبَرَ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَحْياناً: إِذا كانَ اسْمَ اسْتِفْهامٍ (أَيْنَ)، أَوْ كانَ المُبْتَدَأُ مَحْصوراً بِـ «إِنَّما» أَوْ «ما … إِلّا»، أَوْ عادَ ضَميرٌ في المُبْتَدَأِ عَلى الخَبَر (لِلصّائِمِ ثَوابُهُ). مِثال: في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ.

dialogue.ar: في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ.
dialogue.tr: fil-faṣli ṭālib
dialogue.en: In the class there is a student.
dialogue.ur: Class mein ek talib-e-ilm hai.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ أَخي ضَيْفٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda akhī ḍayf
dialogue.en: At my brother's there is a guest.
dialogue.ur: Mere bhai ke paas mehmaan hai.

dialogue.ar: بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بُرْهانٌ.
dialogue.tr: bayna yadayhi burhān
dialogue.en: Between his hands is a proof.
dialogue.ur: Uske saamne daleel hai.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَ المَفَرُّ؟ مَتى نَصْرُ اللهِ؟ كَيْفَ الحالُ؟
dialogue.tr: ayna l-mafarr? matā naṣru llāh? kayfa l-ḥāl?
dialogue.en: Where is the escape? When is Allah's help? How are you?
dialogue.ur: Bhagne ki jagah kahan hai? Allah ki madad kab? Kya haal hai?

dialogue.ar: ما القائِدُ إلّا خالِدٌ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-qāʾidu illā khālid
dialogue.en: The commander is none other than Khalid.
dialogue.ur: Sipah salar sirf Khalid hain.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما الخالِقُ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-khāliqu llāh
dialogue.en: The Creator is Allah alone.
dialogue.ur: Khaaliq sirf Allah hai.

dialogue.ar: لِلصّائِمِ ثَوابُهُ، وَلِلْعامِلَةِ أَجْرُها.
dialogue.tr: liṣ-ṣāʾimi thawābuh, wa lil-ʿāmilati ajruhā
dialogue.en: The fasting person has his reward, the working woman her wage.
dialogue.ur: Rozedaar ke liye uska sawab hai, kaam karne wali ke liye uski ujrat.

q.en: In «في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ», which part comes first?
q.ur: «في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ» mein pehle kya aaya?
q.ar: في «في الفَصْلِ طالِبٌ» أَيُّ جُزْءٍ تَقَدَّمَ؟

q.en: In «أَيْنَ المَفَرُّ؟» the khabar «أَيْنَ» comes first because it is:
In «ما القائِدُ إلّا خالِدٌ», the khabar must come:
q.ar: في «ما القائِدُ إِلّا خالِدٌ» يَجِبُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الخَبَرُ:

options: After the mubtada (limited by ما … إلا)
options_ar: بَعْدَ المُبْتَدَأ، لِأَنَّهُ مَحْصورٌ بِـ ما … إِلّا

q.en: «لِلصّائِمِ ثَوابُهُ»: why must the khabar come first?

options: The pronoun in the mubtada refers to a word in the khabar
options_ar: لِأَنَّ الضَّميرَ في المُبْتَدَأِ يَعودُ عَلى كَلِمَةٍ في الخَبَر

q.ur: "Ke darmiyan" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يَقَعُ في الوَسَطِ مِنْ مَكانَيْن؟
